name: Ishq Mein Tere Sadqay
overview: Zulfiqar Shah is young, handsome, and wealthy, and he falls deeply in love with Hoor. Their love seems perfect, and nothing could keep them apart. But life has other plans. Zulfiqar faces resistance from his family, yet he defies everyone to marry Hoor and fulfill his heart. What begins as a beautiful chapter soon turns tragic, leaving Zulfiqar alone. Yet even in sorrow, fate is not done with him, and a new journey begins. What tragedy befalls Zulfiqar and Hoor? What does fate have in store for him? Can he rebuild his life after this tragedy?
